acceptance_criteria: License verified GPLv3-compatible + provenance header; Gibbs minimiser reproduces a published molten-fluoride equilibrium (e.g. a LiF-BeF2 or FP-fluoride case) within tolerance; release-mode tests green.
description: Port ORNL's Thermochimica: Gibbs-energy-minimization thermochemistry built for nuclear molten salts (FP speciation, oxidation states, UF3/UF4 redox, salt/metal/gas phase partitioning; reads ChemSage/FactSage .dat databases). Highest-value lever for the MSRE fission-product-migration goal. Natural sibling to the just-ported dwsim-libs thermo::gibbs_multiphase (multi-phase Gibbs minimiser) — port the algorithm and feed it molten-fluoride data (MSTDB-TC, separate data-adoption task). Likely a new crate (e.g. outram-park-fork-thermochimica) or an extension module; decide during design. LICENSE: believed permissive/BSD-style — MUST verify against upstream LICENSE/COPYING and confirm GPLv3-compatibility before porting (per workspace provenance rule); drop if GPL-2-only or restricted. Pure-Rust, enum dispatch, uom at boundaries, no FFI. Untrusted AI-assisted draft pending human V&V; verification vs published salt-equilibria before trust.
design: Port the CEF (compound-energy-formalism) / Gibbs-minimiser core + a .dat database reader. Reuse gibbs_multiphase patterns. Molten-fluoride thermodynamic DATA comes from MSTDB (separate task), documented provenance.
